English: Stone Marker
A simple, uncarved standing stone marks the sacred place where the tribe gathers for rituals and guidance.
Wicker Idol
A roughly woven idol of branches and straw, placed beside the stone marker, serves as a focus for seasonal rites and offerings.
Ancestors Patch
A sacred clearing set aside for remembrance of ancestors, decorated with simple totems and earth mounds.
Spirit Stand
A wooden scaffold to hang charms and offerings for the spirits, with painted shields and prayer ribbons.
Priests Shelter
A tented space for the volkhv (priest) and his apprentices, storing ritual tools and sacred relics.
Sacred Pavilion
A large, decorated tent pavilion where the community gathers for great festivals and the priest leads communal rites.
Diviners Room
A wooden structure for the clans diviner, filled with runes, bones, and ritual implements for seeking omens and wisdom.
Blessed Hall
A sturdy timber hall built for sacred feasts and assemblies, adorned with carved icons and blessed by the volkhv.
Sanctuary Circle
A great ring of standing stones and carved logs, encircling the heart of the shrine and guarded by the clans chosen defenders.
West Slavic Shrine
A magnificent sanctuary of wood and stone, with sacred fires, relics, and a council of priests guiding the clans spirit and unity.
